verification.method: scripts/verify/russia.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank 1950/2026/2100, share, decline, density, land area
Peak (1991), gap to the peak, years with more births than deaths (2012–2016), 2026 natural loss and net migration
Men per 100 women 1950/2026 and lowest among countries over 10 million (build check), excess of women
Life expectancy 1990/1994 low/2019/2021/2026; births 1987/1999/2026, fertility 1999 low and 2026
Largest population in Europe and largest land area (build checks); urban share; 2100 total and year below 140 million
Title, meta description, Article headline, FAQ answers in JSON-LD, CSV rows, falling live counter
